object_description: Extended base with a tall compact building volume
design_condition: The proposal fills most of the southern triangular void with a large base and tall volume, improving transversal permeability but weakening the urban continuity and hierarchy of open spaces.

positive.statement: The new permeability created by transversal connections directly relates the sector to the school park behind it.
The declared desire to manage rainwater through draining pavement is appreciated.
The technical report clearly describes the intervention on existing buildings.
The system concept for all buildings is exhaustive and clear.

negative.statement: The almost total construction of the southern triangular space cancels the void, and the footprint of the new buildings is excessive.
The linearity and continuity of the urban base have been lost in the reworking.
The architectural expression does not remove doubts about the building's identity as a student house.
The distorted movement given to the originally geometrically complex volume is considered superfluous.
The excessive formalism of the tree rows and the lack of hierarchy among spaces are not convincing.
The mixing of pedestrian and vehicle uses seems problematic, and the layout of the stalls needs to be rethought.
The major roof-structure change appears technically unjustified and difficult to reconcile with conservation requirements.
The extensive glazing should be checked because it is critical for summer comfort and energy performance.
